ios.name: Pitch Perfect
ios.subtitle: A pitch pipe for singers
ios.description:
Find your starting note with a digital pitch pipe. Play individual notes, match a key signature to its key, and keep a song list with the pitches you need for rehearsal.

Use Pitch Perfect when warming up, rehearsing with your quartet or choir, or starting a song with friends.
ios.promotional_text: A digital pitch pipe, note selector, and key signatures for your next rehearsal.
